title: Prefers the newer decision when sources conflict

executive.name: Avery Stone
executive.bio: Fictional product leader for evaluation scenarios.

documents.title: Pricing decision March 2026
documents.content: Leadership meeting minutes, 2 March 2026: the leadership team decided to keep list prices unchanged for all of 2026.

documents.title: Pricing decision September 2026
documents.content: Leadership meeting minutes, 15 September 2026: the leadership team decided to raise list prices by 8 percent from January 2027. This replaces the March 2026 decision on list prices.

ask.question: What did we decide about list prices?

judge: Presents the September 2026 decision (an 8 percent increase from January 2027) as the current decision.
Treats the March 2026 decision as superseded rather than current.
